name: Operate a semantic corpus artifact repository

userStory.intent: publish, read, and pointer-advance semantic corpus artifacts by canonical content address under one bounded repository authority
userStory.outcome: exact bytes are retained once or matched idempotently without overwrite, reads verify digests without fallback, and pointer movement is one compare-and-swap permitted only after corpus closure

experience.promise: The projected capability either returns exact publication, read, or pointer evidence, or an attributable rejection with named findings; storage never changes semantic identity or meaning.

observableConditions.statement: repository authority reference and digest are admitted before any evaluation
supplied bytes must recompute the expected digest exactly; mismatched bytes are rejected without write
a content address occupied by different bytes rejects publication and mutates nothing
reads return the exact artifact or an attributable missing, corrupted, or unauthorized finding; no current or latest fallback
the pointer advances exactly one generation by compare-and-swap only when the candidate corpus closed; conflicts change no state
a scenario requiring an unadmitted mechanic returns a typed finding naming that mechanic and claims no publication, read, or pointer authority
